# Fork-maintained patches for rayward-external/bifrost
#
# These are CodeQL false-positive suppressions on operator-configured log lines.
# Upstream (maximhq/bifrost) does not carry inline CodeQL annotations.
# If upstream rewrites these plugin files, the suppressions may be lost.
#
# Format: <file> | <grep_pattern_that_proves_patch_is_present> | <human_description>

transports/Dockerfile.custom               | golang:1.26.4                 | build fix: builder image Go must be >= the version in core/go.mod (GOTOOLCHAIN=local won't auto-upgrade); bump in step with go.work on every upstream sync or the image build fails at `go work init`
.github/workflows/snyk.yml                 | astral-sh/setup-uv            | infra fix: use astral-sh/setup-uv, NOT step-security/setup-uv (the latter hard-fails private-repo CI with "Subscription is not valid"); upstream/-X theirs syncs keep reverting this
.github/codeql/codeql-config.yml           | go/incorrect-integer-conversion | FP suppression: protobuf int32 casts are by-design; token counts are internal and in range (rule-level exclude; paths: keys do not work in query-filters)
.github/codeql/codeql-config.yml           | id: go/request-forgery        | FP suppression: all flagged requests target operator-configured endpoints or ValidateExternalURL-guarded URLs (rule-level exclude)
core/utils.go                              | func NewSSRFSafeClient        | security fix: SSRF-safe http.Client that re-validates redirect targets; required by framework/oauth2 + framework/plugins. -X theirs syncs wipe it (leaving net/http unused + callers undefined) — restore or the custom image build fails
transports/bifrost-http/handlers/health.go | func (h *HealthHandler) getLivez | deploy feature: split liveness (/livez, process-only) and readiness (/readyz, short-timeout store pings) probes for GCP Cloud Run (orig PR #45). -X theirs syncs revert health.go to upstream's combined /health only, leaving health_test.go referencing getLivez/getReadyz/pingStores/readinessPingTimeout undefined → test-bifrost-http build fails. Restore from commit 22c98f529 after every sync
framework/oauth2/discovery.go              | Client name len:              | security fix: replaced client-controlled ClientName/RedirectURIs in debug log with counts only
plugins/mocker/main.go                     | math/rand/v2                  | security fix: upgraded from math/rand v1 to v2 for probability/weight routing
framework/logstore/cleaner.go              | math/rand/v2                  | security fix: upgraded from math/rand v1 to v2 for jitter timer
plugins/otel/main.go                       | CodeQL\[go/log-injection\]    | FP suppression: OTEL endpoint is operator config, not user input
plugins/telemetry/main.go                  | CodeQL\[go/log-injection\]    | FP suppression: Prometheus pushgateway URL is operator config, not user input
transports/bifrost-http/handlers/config.go | CodeQL\[go/log-injection\]    | FP suppression: pricing/model-params URLs come from the authenticated admin config API, not untrusted user input
transports/bifrost-http/handlers/config.go | CodeQL\[go/path-injection\]   | FP suppression: file:// path in checkURLAccessibility is admin-supplied, not untrusted input
transports/bifrost-http/handlers/config.go | CodeQL\[go/request-forgery\]  | FP suppression: URL validated by ValidateExternalURL SSRF guard before client.Get
framework/logstore/rdb.go                  | sanitizeDimColumn(string(dimension)) | security fix: route cost/token histogram dimension through sanitizeDimColumn (literal allowlist) like the latency path, breaking go/sql-injection taint into raw SELECT/GROUP BY
.github/workflows/release-pipeline.yml    | GOTEST_SKIP                   | quarantine: skip 5 upstream-broken tests in test-bifrost-http (TestConfigSchemaSync, TestGetVirtualKeys_FromMemoryUsesConfigStore, TestGetVirtualKeys_FromMemoryWithLimitUsesPaginatedConfigStore, TestSQLite_Customer_HashMismatch_FileSync, TestSQLite_Governance_FullReconciliation); REMOVAL CONDITION: remove when the quarantined tests pass on upstream/main
.github/workflows/release-pipeline.yml    | continue-on-error: true       | quarantine: test-migrations continue-on-error (upstream faker coverage validation broken for governance_budgets/governance_customers/governance_model_configs/logs columns); REMOVAL CONDITION: remove when upstream fixes run-migration-tests.sh faker validation and the job passes on upstream/main
.github/workflows/scripts/test-bifrost-http.sh | GOTEST_SKIP              | quarantine support: reads GOTEST_SKIP env var and passes it as -skip flag to go test; remove when upstream-broken tests are fixed and the GOTEST_SKIP workflow env var is removed
.github/workflows/scripts/test-all-plugins.sh  | GOVERNANCE_SKIP           | quarantine: skip 12 stale TestHTTPTransportPreHook_* tests in plugins/governance — routing was migrated from HTTPTransportPreHook to PreRequestHook (upstream commit 12c29d3) but tests were never updated; REMOVAL CONDITION: remove when upstream updates tests to call PreRequestHook
tests/e2e/api/collections/bifrost-api-management.postman_collection.json | 'provider_configs', 'model_configs' | quarantine (stale-upstream-test): the Get-Virtual-Key-Quota .all.keys() assertion expected only 5 keys, but upstream commit 0e73e6a7f (feat: per-model usage in quota API #4287) added a 6th key model_configs to the response without updating its own e2e collection -> test-api-integrations failed. Added 'model_configs' to both the inline assertion and the schema map. REMOVAL CONDITION: drop when upstream adds model_configs to its collection (the assertion would then match upstream)
.github/workflows/alert-bridge.yml             | Alert Bridge               | CI/security: workflow_dispatch bridge for code-scanning alerts (list/dismiss); required because the Claude GitHub App lacks code-scanning API scopes on the fork; re-apply after every -X theirs sync
.github/codeql/codeql-config.yml               | go/weak-sensitive-data-hashing | FP suppression: HashSHA256 in framework/encrypt/encrypt.go is for lookup-index hashes on virtual keys/tokens, not password storage; CodeQL cannot model this distinction
.github/codeql/codeql-config.yml               | go/duplicate-if-branches   | FP suppression: identical else-if/else branches in bedrock provider for extended-thinking config; upstream scaffolding for future differentiation, not a bug
.github/codeql/codeql-config.yml               | go/impossible-interface-nil-check | FP suppression: dead if-nil guard after exhaustive switch in bedrock invoke.go; upstream dead code, not a vulnerability
.github/workflows/dependency-review.yml        | warn-only: true             | policy: dependency-review warns but never blocks — sync PRs bring in upstream transitive deps we cannot unilaterally patch; findings still surface in the PR for awareness

framework/configstore/migrations.go               | raw SQL to bypass BeforeSave | bug fix: migrationAddStoreRawRequestResponseColumn used GORM Updates(map) which triggers BeforeSave hook; on Postgres RETURNING path this left config_hash as empty string for the both_false case (store_raw_request_response=false); use tx.Exec raw SQL to bypass hooks (PR #109, merged 2026-06-10)

examples/mcps/oauth-demo-server/main.go            | redirect_uri must use http or https scheme | security fix: open-redirect guard (scheme/host validation on redirect_uri) and EscapedPath() log safety (CWE-532) — upstream removed both; -X theirs syncs wipe it
examples/mcps/edge-case-server/package.json        | hono.*>=4.12 | security fix: hono >=4.12.23 + @hono/node-server >=1.19.13 overrides and @modelcontextprotocol/sdk ^1.25.3 range — upstream pins old insecure hono 4.12.14; same pattern applies to error-test-server, parallel-test-server, temperature, test-tools-server package.json; -X theirs syncs wipe all five

.github/workflows/scripts/test-core.sh                | GOTEST_SKIP                   | quarantine support: reads GOTEST_SKIP env var and passes it as -skip flag to go test; remove when upstream-broken tests are fixed and the GOTEST_SKIP workflow env var is removed
.github/workflows/release-pipeline.yml                | TestTranscriptionStreamContextCancellation | quarantine: skip 4 Mistral tests with upstream data race in utils.SetupStreamCancellation (idleTimeoutReader.Read races with goroutine cancel); REMOVAL CONDITION: remove when upstream fixes the race in core/providers/utils/utils.go SetupStreamCancellation
.github/workflows/scripts/test-all-plugins.sh          | SEMANTICCACHE_SKIP             | quarantine: skip 11 semanticcache tests requiring OpenAI API access or real upstream latency (TestSemanticSimilarityEdgeCases, TestNormalizationWithSemanticCache, TestTextNormalizationDirectCache, TestCacheNoStoreReadButNoWrite, TestSemanticSearch, TestDirectVsSemanticSearch, TestCrossCacheTypeAccessibility, TestMultipleCacheEntriesPriority, TestResponsesAPISemanticMatching, TestStreamingCacheBasicFunctionality, TestSemanticCacheBasicFunctionality); REMOVAL CONDITION: remove when fork adds OPENAI_API_KEY secret or upstream mocks the embedder/TTS
